title: The Eleventh Reading

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The slate does not know it has been read. The house does, and keeps the count in loaves.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of Low Kiln, told under the moot-post when the eleventh figure went up

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and seventy-eight to three hundred and eighty days, six months and one hundred and ninety-eight to two hundred days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 108 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break and no tagged memory. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it now holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth and found where put on three mornings and three goings of the light, with no second fold, no third crust and no name spoken over it; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the deep winter's last tend: the kiln in its winter rhythm, the river under its skin, the yard going around its seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest, the hearth grammar at both ends, the twice-mended pot kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain covered and unfigured. Its earned event is Stone 20, the month's second Account-day and market: eleven readings stand behind one unsigned figure and eleven are not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, Stone's second true subtraction riding up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box with the key in a coat pocket that does not come back down. The keeping at the fold is found where put on three more mornings and three more goings of the light and still not made again: a hand that finds is not a hand that places, a fourth would not be a habit until a hand placed twice, and both want a payer where none stands. Point of view never leaves the basket; no Court interior, no back room, no Debt Loft entered.
places: the reading block under the moot-post
the moot-post's finger's width of shade
the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: A Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{378}{Stone 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof with the hand laid flat on answer 330 and the count exact at 377 carried out of Chapter 108, moving into the first morning after the keeping's three-day test. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg behind the door, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey hairline called the thaw left unswept, the twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, the unforged collector sentence at the kindling, the tile debt circled without a name). No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. No recap: nothing from Stone 16, 17 or 18 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the keeping is not made a habit on this morning. Dramatic purpose: the fourth finding proves again that finding is not placing. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — leathery brown-edged crust gone harder in the dry cold, its corner a hair off the wool; the wool folded once in the empty place exactly where put on the fifteenth; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; a face composed by cold is not composure and pink returning is surface still cold and not the core — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). He finds the keeping where put a fourth time, adds no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, files it on a place of its own beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps in the room whose floor does not touch this one, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place with a finger between it and the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper; a fourth finding with no placing is not a habit, for a habit wants a hand that places twice, and no such hand stood (T097, held and not paid). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar standing cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person; the dressed grain is turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure and no handful; the pot rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth was made due. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 378 days; overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not; three counts in three places and none rises into another. Ten arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of ten; their ten true subtractions ride locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down. In the small hours the hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. File answer 331: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the ten readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the river's skin, the widow's mark nor the keeping at the fold. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell, four, four and a gap.

scenes.title: The Well and the Seven Places
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 19 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper, Ilva once at the yard well; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier shifting a hare across his shoulders, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling and two fence-menders. No Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the household's arithmetic is present and none of it stands up and calls itself an account, and the keeping is not made a second time at the going of the light. Sella carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, level and out of the draught; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, by nothing measurable and once and not twice, because a second going-around would make a figure of once and a figure wants a payer standing under it (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The clean dark line at the Vail corner keeps its finer grey hairline called the thaw, unswept and thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash coming up off it; under the lowest rack the broken birth-slates lie entered by nobody; at the rack end the round ring where the shallow pan once stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word. The gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin drawn edge to edge across the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, not a fourth covering and not a sixth low thing; through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, and over it from bank to bank lies the winter skin the cold put on and the cold will take off, found where put and not made again, not spent on the afternoon's work or the going of the light (T083/T085). At the well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hand goes to her sleeve before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with the half-beat, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. The notched strip of birch lies in her fold, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal under the loaf shelf, to the cord or the knot-string, and no figure comes off the wood. The boy takes the order of her reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and files it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files no tenth, makes no reader of her keeping and joins her to none (T080, advanced, not paid). The walk-ons bring directions and never figures: hare to the weather that carried the snow and can carry the price, cracked jar to a pot that says nothing, and to the woman with kindling asking what the seventh year will want and the two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late, Tarn says Yes, house to each and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument finds a foot. At the kindling the account stands in its old exactness: six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt; the small knife lies at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a hand could also slip it off; Tarn passes his hand over blade and sill as over a tool put back where it belongs, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, cuts nothing, counts nothing, spends nothing, and does not look along the road. The Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again, beside the five held objects and the pot-crack resting with a finger between every pair, not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping, not the calling of the loan, with no payer standing; the pale clip-ring at his left wrist catches what little light there is and gives it back, his chest has been tight since the dark and the Ash is worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, his stroke going over the flagstones' shallow bright patch without the half-check. He brings the ear-sentence up to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease where a hand had opened, and it is not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed have gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and no word that the room was cold; dusty forearms and clean ones are kept on one tray and parted as clot from vessel, asking neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate while the broken ones lie under the lowest rack; he speaks to the wheel before any person — It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady — and tells a pot You'll do with no welcome in it and no unkindness either, knowing the full note it will give three turns before it leaves his hands, with air under it and a want in it, and withholding the knowing from any master come up from High Kiln who would call it early and sing a pot before its time. When Sella has not finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of her sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and is left standing so the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around the waiting as cloth straightens when a weight is lifted — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies — and the finger comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time. He's not Vail stays sealed as a lid nobody has tried to lift in three years; the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five and the three Ash directions (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella carries him up the nineteen steps under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him on his bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and does not tuck a second fold into the empty place; her hand does only what the setting needs and goes away, the little-door burn closes on air, the thread is left frozen and unwiped and she says nothing of where they have been. The keeping is found where put at the going of the light and not made again. The hearth grammar is renewed and the wider file checked without standing up; in the small hours the hand lays itself flat on the fold on answer 332, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: Eleven and Not One Account
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{379}{Stone 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the chapter's earned event, the deep-winter month's second Account-day and market. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Berr Clay, Hessa Rale; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the two hundred at the Cross, the soft-cuffed Fishstairs clerk set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, the silent green-mouthed woman at the pot board and the small shape in cast-offs at the market's edge, a Cold Acre hare-carrier and a cracked-jar man. No Ilva, Drawing collector, ownerless voice or seventh of the green or the shape. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Stone 19 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the eleventh figure goes up and eleven are eleven and not one account. In the small hours the hand laid flat on answer 332 and the count exact at 378 are carried into the morning without ceremony; the surgeon takes the body in its old order and finds the wool folded once where put a fifth time, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, and files it beside the crust's gap and the shelf's two gaps with a finger between it and every other kept thing (T097/T060/T086, held). Sella carries him down the nineteen steps before first light at the half-pace she keeps from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell with no reason given to the basket; the widow's mark hangs untouched, for a market and a Cross are not openings and an account wants a hand at the mark and none stands (T058/T079). Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, and under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all; his hands are large and clean and he wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds the narrow slate unopened against his forearm, passes a finger over the figure through his sleeve and reads one in twelve, as the notice says low into the goers-by twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late. He calls the levy and denies it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, takes himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, says something low to the block about kindness being entered, and goes off up the clay road with the box locked and Stone's second true subtraction inside beside the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone and the first, second and third of Ash. Eleven arithmetics now stand behind one unsigned figure: eleven are eleven and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven; the finding that eleven are not one account is kept on a place of its own with a finger between it and every other kept thing and is not a grievance, a sign, a power or a lesson (T015/T041/T047, advanced, not paid; T077, the dressed grain at home read over by a figure that does not know what it cost). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night and not folded into the count or made a seventh (T078). Hessa Rale takes Berr's narrow slate up the clay road before noon, edge-on to her forearm with the writing turned toward her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the second strap let out and pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt; to the woman who asks what she carries she says I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which, gives no figure and is not made a reader by the eleventh arithmetic; her eighth record-first hand stays eight with no tenth, filed beside the Ash 6 sighting with no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no witness, no reader and no payment (T080). Below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, his cuff grey from washing and the grey worked into the seam at the wrist, his hand to the slate before his eye to the stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090). Across the square at the pot board a silent woman with clay under her nails, a pale line across the back of one hand and the sweetish green of lead glaze at one mouth-corner turns a cup a quarter and sets it back where it stood, and at the market's edge a small shape in cast-offs catches the light on a green sliver and goes dull — the seventh green and the seventh shape with no eighth of either, unnamed, unjoined, never Fenna and never Ulda in the narration, not made a hearing, a cause or a romance (T050/T051, T033/T034, held). Four rooms keep the same gap in their count — the birth room in House Silt, the Vail kiln-house, the room where the slate was read on market-day and the Drawing house seen two doors down — held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four, and no such hand standing and no such payer; the keeping at the fold sits beside these on its own place and is not laid across any of them (T081, advanced, not paid). Sella carries him home at the going of the light saying nothing of where they have been or what was read over the basket, sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold. The river's winter skin is found where put beside water over water and is not spent on the reading, the market or the going of the light. In the small hours the hand takes its small intake on the note's own finishing, lays itself flat on the fold on answer 333, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, and the count stands at 379 exact, six months and one hundred and ninety-nine days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: What the Reading Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon after Stone 20's reading, the yard going around its places, the kindling and the damper checked, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed, and the small hours at the close of the day with answer 334. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the three Ash directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: nothing from the eleventh reading crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the keeping remains a keeping on the evening of the market. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, by nothing measurable and once and not twice; the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw stay unswept, the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody, and the round ring where the shallow pan stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word. The three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the river's skin stays on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent on the reading or the going of the light and not made to buy a lesson under any roof (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where they were put and makes neither again, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; he does not look along the road. Two ears, two silences, a loan that can hear and has never been called, and nobody to enter it; Garl's name has gone unspoken under this roof 379 days and the carried fire's fifth has gone unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed, and the two counts stand side by side and do not become one (T036/T076/T006, T088). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease where a hand had opened, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed had gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and no word that the room was cold; dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray are parted as clot from vessel, he speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master, and his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time — one iron with two bites and no Grathic word covering both mercies. He's not Vail stays sealed; the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, and the eleven arithmetics going up the clay road in a locked box brought no loosening of it and no word under the wheel-shed (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face, leaves the wool folded once in the empty place exactly where she put it on the fifteenth, and adds no second fold, no third crust and no name; her hand does only what the setting needs and goes away, the little-door burn closes on air, the thread is left frozen and unwiped, and she says nothing of where they have been. The boy files the keeping on its own place beside the crust's gap and the shelf's two gaps, gathered once, found where put on four mornings and four goings of the light and not made again. The far-off finger that would one day lay shelf and fold together and call the joining an account is still far off and is not his; it has not come. Under the roof Sella goes to the hearth before the basket as she has at both ends of every day for three years, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow's mark hangs untouched — a going of the light and a hearth are not openings and no eighth was made due. Under the floor four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood; overhead four nails, four and a knot. The wider file is checked without standing up: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told; nine record-first hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth; eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of eleven — nothing lifted out of its place to make a row come out even. In the small hours the hand lays itself flat on the fold on answer 334, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: A Sixth Morning

scenes.title: The Count Goes On
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 21, the yard going around its places, the kindling and the damper checked, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed, and the small hours at the very end of the day with the file out on the towel and answer 336. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail in the afternoon; Garl Vail in objects. Dramatic purpose: check every object and find every gap left gap, let the eleven readings and the keeping gather interest without being paid, and close on forward motion toward the year's last reading. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out; the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw stay unswept, the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody, and at the rack end the round ring where the shallow pan once stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word. The three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and the river's skin stays on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent on the going of the light or the day's work (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note over a lower note, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, muffled under the winter skin as a voice is muffled by a shut door, with no hand that laid the skin, no payer under it and no source standing to be asked. At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where they were put and makes neither again, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; he does not look along the road. His chest has been tight since the dark, the Ash is worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist catches what little light there is and gives it back, and his stroke goes over the flagstones' shallow bright patch without the half-check. The loan that can hear remains uncalled and the seventh year at its very end is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease where a hand had opened, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed had gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and no word that the room was cold; he keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray and parts them as clot from vessel, speaking to the wheel before any person — It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady — and telling a pot You'll do with no welcome in it and no unkindness either, knowing the full note it will give three turns before it leaves his hands, with air under it and a want in it, and withholding the knowing from any High Kiln master who would call it early and sing a pot before its time. His bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and is left standing so the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around the waiting — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies — and the finger comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, gathered once on a place of its own and not made again. He's not Vail stays sealed as a lid nobody has tried to lift in three years; the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five and the three Ash directions, which stand where put and do not repeat (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella carries him up the nineteen steps under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him on his bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and leaves the wool folded once in the crust's empty place exactly where she put it on the fifteenth. No second fold, no third crust, no name spoken over the place, no gift (a gift wants a giver and nobody gave), no payment, no payer, not a joining of rooms, not a sixth held object, not a habit, way, sign, hearing, mending, cause or rule; her hand does only what the setting needs and goes away, the little-door burn closes on air, the thread is left frozen and unwiped and she says nothing of where they have been. **The keeping, advanced and NOT paid (T097 with T060/T086):** it is found where put on six mornings and six goings of the light and not made again, and a finding is not a placing; it gathers interest on its own place beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place toward the far-off finger that will one day lay shelf and fold together and call the joining an account — that hand is not his and has not come, and the account wants a hand to lay the places together and a payer under all of them, and no hand stands and no payer stands. Under the roof the hearth grammar is renewed — coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. Repair stays apart from restoration: a restored thing hides the hand that handled it and a mended thing leaves that hand showing. The widow's mark hangs untouched, for a going of the light and a hearth are not openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth was made due. In the small hours the file comes out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and the boy goes over it by the place of each thing with every gap left gap. Three hundred and thirty-five honest answers stand on the sixth place and the three hundred and thirty-sixth is to come. The five held objects stand with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them, each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair. The keeping at the fold is found where put and not made again. The ninth record-first hand keeps no tenth — Hessa Rale's eighth, Ilva's ninth and the collector's ordinary hand on a tray of its own joined to none — and the nine stoppings keep no tenth before the seventh year at its very end. The burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, and none was made a sixth of on a day that had not earned one. Four rooms keep the same gap in their count held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account; eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, Ash's first, second and third, Stone's first and Stone's second — the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, their eleven true subtractions riding in Berr Clay's box up the clay road locked toward High Kiln, unread under this roof, the key gone up in a coat pocket and not coming back down. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among, the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources; the seventh place stays empty and was not dug for or filled, and the flat knock of the Drawing stands on its own place outside them. The heard bell of the Long Night stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and is not folded into any of them. The river's winter skin stands on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent, and the promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn and the loan uncalled. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand, tenth stopping or twelfth arithmetic was supplied to make a row come out even, for a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged; the finding that eleven are not one account sits on a place of its own with a finger between it and every other kept thing, and the keeping at the fold sits beside all of these and is not laid across any of them. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the low note under the finger's-width door as a hand goes up in a field it has learned not to disturb, does not reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; the note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go is neither early nor stayed and the hand does not stay. File answer 336: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found, and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work. The count stands at 380 exact, six months and two hundred days told by nobody who would have known what a number counted; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number. Stone kept its nineteenth, twentieth and twenty-first days without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month held both its names, older women by weather and slatemen by Account-days, neither set right nor left in so many words, and the count went on under the Vail roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath. Stone 22 (Day 381), the year's last working week and the eleventh reading behind, stands ahead unbrought; Stone 30 (Day 389), the year's third and last Account-day and the twelfth arithmetic, stands further still; the Five stand beyond it. Forward, not closed.
